# admin-ui

React component library providing design tokens, primitives, overlays, navigation, and layout components for admin interfaces.

## Install & Import

```ts
// Stylesheet (single CSS bundle with all tokens and component styles)
import 'admin-ui/styles';

// Components
import { Button, Card, Text, SideNav, Modal } from 'admin-ui';
```

## Dark Mode

Set `data-theme="dark"` on any ancestor element. All tokens swap automatically.

```html
<div data-theme="dark">...</div>
```

## CSS Rules

- CSS Modules only — no inline styles, no global class names.
- Use `--admin-*` semantic tokens in component styles.
- Never reference primitive color tokens directly.

---

## Components

### Primitives

**Avatar**
```tsx
<Avatar name="Jane Doe" src="/photo.jpg" size="md" />
```
Props: `name: string`, `src?: string`, `size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, `className?: string`

**Badge**
```tsx
<Badge variant="success" size="md">Active</Badge>
```
Props: `variant?: 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'info'`, `size?: 'sm' | 'md'`, `children: ReactNode`, `className?: string`

**Banner**
```tsx
<Banner variant="warning" message="Disk usage at 90%" title="Warning" dismissible />
```
Props: `variant: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'`, `message: string`, `title?: string`, `icon?: LucideIcon`, `dismissible?: boolean`, `onDismiss?: () => void`, `layout?: 'inline' | 'full'`, `className?: string`

**Blockquote**
```tsx
<Blockquote cite="Author Name">Quoted text here.</Blockquote>
```
Props: `children: ReactNode`, `cite?: string`, `className?: string`

**Breadcrumb**
```tsx
<Breadcrumb items={[{ label: 'Home', onClick: goHome }, { label: 'Settings' }]} />
```
Props: `items: BreadcrumbItem[]`, `separator?: ReactNode` (default `'/'`), `className?: string`
BreadcrumbItem: `{ label: string, href?: string, onClick?: () => void }`

**BulletList**
```tsx
<BulletList items={['First item', 'Second item']} size="md" />
```
Props: `items: string[]`, `size?: 'sm' | 'md'`, `className?: string`

**Button**
```tsx
<Button variant="primary" size="md" onClick={handleClick}>Save</Button>
```
Props: `variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost'`, `size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, `disabled?: boolean`, `children: ReactNode`, `onClick?: () => void`, `type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'`, `className?: string`, `aria-label?: string`

**ButtonGroup**
```tsx
<ButtonGroup align="end">
  <Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button>
  <Button>Save</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
```
Props: `children: ReactNode`, `align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end'`, `className?: string`

**Card**
```tsx
<Card hoverable active={isSelected} onClick={handleSelect}>Content</Card>
```
Props: `children: ReactNode`, `active?: boolean`, `hoverable?: boolean`, `onClick?: () => void`, `className?: string`

**Carousel**
```tsx
<Carousel slidesPerView={3} gap={16} loop>{slides}</Carousel>
```
Props: `children: ReactNode`, `slidesPerView?: number`, `gap?: number`, `loop?: boolean`, `className?: string`

**Checkbox**
```tsx
<Checkbox checked={isChecked} onChange={setChecked} label="Accept terms" />
```
Props: `checked: boolean`, `onChange: (checked: boolean) => void`, `label?: string`, `disabled?: boolean`, `className?: string`, `id?: string`

**CodeBlock**
```tsx
<CodeBlock language="typescript" showLineNumbers>{codeString}</CodeBlock>
```
Props: `children: string`, `language?: string`, `showLineNumbers?: boolean`, `className?: string`

**Input**
```tsx
<Input value={name} onChange={setName} label="Name" error={nameError} />
```
Props: `value: string`, `onChange: (value: string) => void`, `type?: string`, `label?: string`, `error?: string`, `helperText?: string`, `min?: number`, `max?: number`, `id?: string`

**NumberedList**
```tsx
<NumberedList items={['Step one', 'Step two']} start={1} />
```
Props: `items: string[]`, `size?: 'sm' | 'md'`, `start?: number`, `className?: string`

**Select**
```tsx
<Select options={options} value={selected} onChange={setSelected} placeholder="Choose..." />
```
Props: `options: SelectOption[]`, `value?: string`, `onChange: (value: string) => void`, `placeholder?: string`, `disabled?: boolean`, `size?: 'sm' | 'md'`, `className?: string`
SelectOption: `{ value: string, label: string, disabled?: boolean }`

**SelectionList**
```tsx
<SelectionList items={items} value={selected} onChange={setSelected} columns={2} />
```
Props: `items: SelectionListItem[]`, `value?: string`, `onChange?: (value: string) => void`, `columns?: 1 | 2 | 3`, `className?: string`, `aria-label?: string`
SelectionListItem: `{ value: string, label: string, description?: string }`

**Table**
```tsx
<Table columns={columns} data={rows} rowKey="id" striped compact />
```
Props: `columns: TableColumn[]`, `data: T[]`, `rowKey: string | ((row: T) => string)`, `striped?: boolean`, `compact?: boolean`, `className?: string`
TableColumn: `{ key: string, header: string, width?: string, render?: (value, row) => ReactNode }`

**Tabs**
```tsx
<Tabs tabs={[{ id: 'a', label: 'Tab A' }]} activeId="a" onChange={setTab} />
```
Props: `tabs: TabItem[]`, `activeId: string`, `onChange: (id: string) => void`, `size?: 'sm' | 'md'`, `className?: string`
TabItem: `{ id: string, label: string }`

**Text**
```tsx
<Text variant="heading-m" as="h2" color="primary">Title</Text>
```
Props: `variant: TextVariant`, `as?: 'span' | 'p' | 'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6' | 'label' | 'div' | 'li'`, `color?: TextColor`, `className?: string`, `children: ReactNode`
TextVariant: `'heading-xl' | 'heading-l' | 'heading-m' | 'heading-s' | 'heading-xs' | 'overline' | 'body-m' | 'body-s' | 'body-xs' | 'body-m-strong' | 'body-s-strong' | 'body-xs-strong'`
TextColor: `'primary' | 'secondary' | 'subtle' | 'highlight' | 'warning' | 'inverted-primary'`

**Toggle**
```tsx
<Toggle checked={isOn} onChange={setOn} label="Enable feature" />
```
Props: `checked: boolean`, `onChange: (checked: boolean) => void`, `label?: string`, `disabled?: boolean`, `size?: 'sm' | 'md'`, `className?: string`, `id?: string`

**ToolbarButton**
```tsx
import { Settings } from 'lucide-react';
<ToolbarButton icon={Settings} onClick={openSettings} aria-label="Settings" />
```
Props: `icon: LucideIcon`, `onClick?: () => void`, `size?: 'sm' | 'md'`, `pressed?: boolean`, `aria-label?: string`, `title?: string`, `className?: string`

### Overlays

**AlertDialog**
```tsx
<AlertDialog
  isOpen={showConfirm}
  title="Delete item?"
  description="This action cannot be undone."
  variant="destructive"
  onConfirm={handleDelete}
  onCancel={() => setShowConfirm(false)}
/>
```
Props: `isOpen: boolean`, `onConfirm: () => void`, `onCancel: () => void`, `title: string`, `description: string`, `confirmLabel?: string`, `cancelLabel?: string`, `variant?: 'default' | 'destructive'`

**ContextMenu**
```tsx
<ContextMenu items={[{ label: 'Edit', onClick: edit }, { label: 'Delete', variant: 'destructive', onClick: remove }]}>
  <div>Right-click me</div>
</ContextMenu>
```
Props: `children: ReactNode`, `items: ContextMenuItem[]`, `className?: string`
ContextMenuItem: `{ label: string, onClick?: () => void, shortcut?: string, variant?: 'default' | 'destructive', disabled?: boolean, separator?: boolean }`

**Modal**
```tsx
<Modal isOpen={showModal} onClose={() => setShowModal(false)} title="Edit Profile" footer={<Button>Save</Button>}>
  <p>Modal content here</p>
</Modal>
```
Props: `isOpen: boolean`, `onClose: () => void`, `children: ReactNode`, `title?: string`, `footer?: ReactNode`, `headerBorder?: boolean`, `footerBorder?: boolean`, `maxWidth?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`

**SidePanel**
```tsx
<SidePanel isOpen={showPanel} onClose={closePanel} title="Details" width="md">
  <p>Panel content</p>
</SidePanel>
```
Props: `isOpen: boolean`, `onClose: () => void`, `children: ReactNode`, `title?: string`, `footer?: ReactNode`, `width?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`

### Navigation

**SideNav**
```tsx
<SideNav
  sections={[{ label: 'Main', items: [{ id: 'home', label: 'Home' }] }]}
  activeId="home"
  onSelect={setActiveId}
  searchable
/>
```
Props: `sections: SideNavSectionData[]`, `activeId?: string`, `onSelect: (id: string) => void`, `searchable?: boolean`, `searchPlaceholder?: string`, `className?: string`
SideNavSectionData: `{ label?: string, items: SideNavItemData[] }`
SideNavItemData: `{ id: string, label: string }`

**TopNav**
```tsx
<TopNav
  brand={<Logo />}
  tabs={[{ id: 'flows', label: 'Flows' }]}
  activeTabId="flows"
  onTabSelect={setActiveTab}
  actions={<ToolbarButton icon={Settings} />}
/>
```
Props: `brand?: ReactNode`, `onBrandClick?: () => void`, `tabs: TopNavTabData[]`, `activeTabId?: string`, `onTabSelect?: (id: string) => void`, `actions?: ReactNode`, `className?: string`
TopNavTabData: `{ id: string, label: string }`

**Pagination**
```tsx
<Pagination currentPage={3} totalPages={10} onPageChange={setPage} variant="numbered" />
```
Props: `currentPage: number`, `totalPages: number`, `onPageChange: (page: number) => void`, `variant?: 'buttons' | 'numbered' | 'dots'`, `className?: string`

### Layout

**DocPage**
```tsx
<DocPage content={markdownString} />
```
Props: `content: string`, `className?: string`

**PageHeading**
```tsx
<PageHeading title="Dashboard" description="Overview of all systems" actions={<Button>Export</Button>} />
```
Props: `title: string`, `description?: string`, `actions?: ReactNode`, `className?: string`

**SectionHeading**
```tsx
<SectionHeading title="Configuration" size="md" actions={<Button size="sm">Edit</Button>} />
```
Props: `title: string`, `description?: string`, `size?: 'lg' | 'md' | 'sm'`, `actions?: ReactNode`, `className?: string`

**PageFooter**
```tsx
<PageFooter align="right" border>
  <ButtonGroup><Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button><Button>Save</Button></ButtonGroup>
</PageFooter>
```
Props: `children: ReactNode`, `align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right'`, `border?: boolean`, `className?: string`

---

## Semantic Design Tokens

Use these `--admin-*` CSS custom properties in component styles. Never reference primitive tokens directly.

### Surface
| Token | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `--admin-surface-primary` | Main content surface |
| `--admin-surface-secondary` | Secondary surface |
| `--admin-surface-mid` | Mid-tone surface |
| `--admin-surface-subtle` | Subtle background |
| `--admin-surface-extra-subtle` | Extra-subtle background |
| `--admin-surface-action` | Action/CTA surface |
| `--admin-surface-highlight` | Highlight/accent surface |
| `--admin-surface-inverted-primary` | Inverted primary |
| `--admin-surface-inverted-subtle` | Inverted subtle |
| `--admin-surface-inverted-extra-subtle` | Inverted extra-subtle |

### Text
| Token | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `--admin-text-primary` | Default text |
| `--admin-text-secondary` | Secondary text |
| `--admin-text-subtle` | Subtle/muted text |
| `--admin-text-highlight` | Link/accent text |
| `--admin-text-warning` | Warning text |
| `--admin-text-annotation` | Annotation text |
| `--admin-text-success` | Success text |
| `--admin-text-error` | Error text |
| `--admin-text-info` | Informational text |
| `--admin-text-inverted-primary` | Inverted primary text |
| `--admin-text-inverted-secondary` | Inverted secondary text |
| `--admin-text-inverted-subtle` | Inverted subtle text |

### Background
| Token | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `--admin-background-primary` | Page background |
| `--admin-background-inverted-primary` | Inverted page background |
| `--admin-background-mid` | Mid-tone background |
| `--admin-background-inverted-secondary` | Inverted secondary |
| `--admin-background-subtle` | Subtle background |
| `--admin-background-extra-subtle` | Extra-subtle background |
| `--admin-background-highlight` | Highlight background |
| `--admin-background-annotation` | Annotation background |
| `--admin-background-annotation-subtle` | Subtle annotation background |

### Border
| Token | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `--admin-border-prominent` | Prominent borders |
| `--admin-border-subtle` | Subtle borders |
| `--admin-border-inverted-prominent` | Inverted prominent |
| `--admin-border-inverted-subtle` | Inverted subtle |

### Status Surfaces
| Token | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `--admin-surface-warning-primary` | Warning primary |
| `--admin-surface-warning-secondary` | Warning secondary |
| `--admin-surface-warning-subtle` | Warning subtle |
| `--admin-surface-success-primary` | Success primary |
| `--admin-surface-success-secondary` | Success secondary |
| `--admin-surface-success-subtle` | Success subtle |
| `--admin-surface-error-primary` | Error primary |
| `--admin-surface-error-secondary` | Error secondary |
| `--admin-surface-error-subtle` | Error subtle |
| `--admin-surface-info-primary` | Info primary |
| `--admin-surface-info-secondary` | Info secondary |
| `--admin-surface-info-subtle` | Info subtle |

### Interactive & Elevation
| Token | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `--admin-interactive-subtle` | Subtle interactive background |
| `--admin-interactive-focus` | Focus state background |
| `--admin-overlay` | Modal/overlay backdrop |
| `--admin-elevate-1` | Hover state overlay |
| `--admin-elevate-2` | Active state overlay |

### Spacing
| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `--admin-space-xxl` | 4rem (64px) |
| `--admin-space-xl` | 2rem (32px) |
| `--admin-space-l` | 1.25rem (20px) |
| `--admin-space-m` | 1rem (16px) |
| `--admin-space-s` | 0.5rem (8px) |
| `--admin-space-xs` | 0.25rem (4px) |

### Typography
| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `--admin-font-size-4xl` | 2.25rem (36px) |
| `--admin-font-size-3xl` | 1.875rem (30px) |
| `--admin-font-size-2xl` | 1.5rem (24px) |
| `--admin-font-size-xl` | 1.25rem (20px) |
| `--admin-font-size-l` | 1rem (16px) |
| `--admin-font-size-m` | 0.875rem (14px) |
| `--admin-font-size-s` | 0.8rem (12.8px) |
| `--admin-font-size-xs` | 0.75rem (12px) |

### Radius
| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `--admin-radius-sm` | radius - 4px |
| `--admin-radius-md` | radius - 2px |
| `--admin-radius-lg` | 0.75rem (12px) |
| `--admin-radius-xl` | radius + 4px |
